title: Albert Wesker's last stand in Resident Evil 5
subject: wesker
description:
Did Wesker deserve that ending? 👇

From Ozwell Spencer's confession to the volcano in Kijuju. Spoilers for Resident Evil 5.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: A dying old man told Wesker what he really was.
In 2006, at his estate in Europe, Ozwell Spencer revealed the Wesker Project. Albert was bred for a world ruled by gods.
Wesker killed him that night and decided he would be the god instead.
His plan was Uroboros, a virus he would spread across the planet from a bomber.
In 2009, Chris Redfield and Sheva Alomar stopped him in Kijuju, and the fight ended inside a volcano.
Weakened by his own serum, Wesker sank into the lava. Two rockets from a helicopter ended Spencer's last experiment.
